journey.name: wear ambient hides balance
journey.description:
In ambient mode the balance is replaced by a dimmed Bitkit mark and the NFC hint is hidden; waking the watch brings the balance back. Emulator and physical watch (on a watch, lowering the wrist or covering the screen with a palm does the same as `KEYCODE_SLEEP`).
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet, on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped, and the always-on screen on (README › Watch gestures). Backend: hosted regtest. The NFC hint shows only on a watch with NFC on; the emulators have no NFC, so there the "NfcHint" checks expect it absent throughout.

actions.action: Verify "WatchHomeBalance" is listed, and "NfcHint" too on a watch with NFC on
Run `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP` and wait 3 s
Verify "WatchHomeBalanceHidden" is listed with the content-desc "Balance hidden", and "WatchHomeBalance", "WatchHomeBalanceSecondary" and "NfcHint" are not
Verify from a screenshot that the screen shows the time, a dimmed Bitkit mark and the page dots, and no amount
Run `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP` and wait 2 s
Verify "WatchHomeBalance" is listed again, "NfcHint" too on a watch with NFC on, and "WatchHomeBalanceHidden" is not
